detail.longDescription: Self-hosting savings depend on what you actually stop paying for. Compare the subscriptions you'd cancel against hardware, backup storage, electricity and upkeep. Reusing a PC helps the upfront cost; its idle power still matters if it runs 24/7. Put your own numbers into the calculator: https:// techfuelhq.com/tools/selfhost- breakeven/?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=distribution-2026-10&utm_content=breakeven-inputs # SelfHosted # Homelab
